productionConcept: An enduring trap mastery emblem: two stout crossed hooked trap teeth and a tight dark chain knot, with a small root-like thorn tendril reinforcing the knot. Static substantial iron shapes signify sustained binding, not an exploding active trap.

No lettering, numbers, watermark, border, icon frame, medallion rim, UI panel, floor, cast shadow, scenery, solid backdrop, checkerboard or matte. Do not bake any background; preserve native alpha.
